integrity: The unrestricted proof is symbolic. It independently reconstructs the conic equation and recurrence from the cited source, proves both gcd identities, and uses a finite checker only as corroboration rather than as evidence for the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: The result is a structural reduction and proves component uniqueness only for crystals with exactly two distinct prime divisors; the full uniqueness conjecture for larger prime support remains unproved.
title: Coprime component structure of biharmonic crystals
